harnesses.name: Cursor / Cursor CLI
harnesses.notes: Cursor CLI reads the same folders. Cursor also loads .agents/skills, .claude/skills, and .codex/skills.

harnesses.name: Claude / Claude Code
harnesses.notes: Nested .claude/skills folders inside subdirectories also load when working there.

harnesses.name: Antigravity
harnesses.notes: Older versions use .agent/skills. Antigravity 2.0 documents ~/.gemini/config/skills for user scope; the IDE and codelab use ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills.

harnesses.name: Cline
harnesses.verify: Open the Skills tab in the Cline panel to see and toggle installed skills.
harnesses.notes: The name field must match the folder name exactly.

harnesses.name: Kilo Code
harnesses.verify: Run `kilo debug skill` to list the skills Kilo discovered.
harnesses.notes: Folders named skills-<mode>, such as skills-code, load only in that mode.

harnesses.name: Kiro
harnesses.notes: Workspace skills take priority over user skills with the same name.

harnesses.name: Codex
harnesses.notes: Scan paths come from community guides; /etc/codex/skills is the admin location. Codex configuration lives in ~/.codex.

harnesses.name: GitHub Copilot
harnesses.notes: Copilot also reads .claude/skills and .agents/skills. Works in VS Code agent mode, Copilot CLI, and the cloud agent.

harnesses.name: Muse Code
harnesses.verify: Run `muse skills list` to see the skills Muse discovered.
harnesses.notes: Based on one community report: muse skills list scans ~/.agents/skills, ~/.claude/skills, and ~/.codex/skills.
